Never modify files under `ledgerly/customer_export/` without posting the proposed diff in `#privacy-review` and receiving approval from `@mina`.

Never run Bandit on `ledgerly` without invoking it through `./tools/scan-ledgerly.sh` so its custom exclusions and baseline comparison are applied.

Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

## Current objective
Fix refund double-counting in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`. The Tenacity refactor is paused until next sprint.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Active schema: `billing_v3`. `billing_v1` is a frozen finance snapshot; never seed or write into it. `billing_v1` is superseded as active.

## Ruled-out approaches
Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours made stuck jobs invisible for hours; do not retry.

## Plan and progress
- [done] Stop Tenacity refactor.
- [pending] Inspect reconciliation logic: `sed -n '1,260p' ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`
- [pending] Identify refund aggregation path and add a regression test.

## Recent work
Invoice credit ordering was identified as a likely cause of the `87.50` versus `90.00` mismatch. Test setup was refactored with factories, rollback, batch customers, and a frozen clock; targeted suites passed. Latest: `tests/test_reports.py` passed 28/28.
